title: Mixing: Hands Of Love by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

‘Hands Of Love’ by Wings was mixed in stereo on 13 January 1973.

A rough mix had been made on 10 January, and taken away by Paul McCartney. On this day the final mix was made in three attempts.

In the evening, Paul and Linda McCartney watched Eric Clapton perform at the Rainbow Theatre in London. He was backed with a supergroup: Pete Townshend and Ron Wood on guitar, Steve Winwood on keyboards, Rich Grech on bass guitar, Jim Capaldi and Jimmy Karstein on drums, and Rebop Kwaku Baah on percussion. Also in the audience were Ringo Starr, Elton John, Donovan, Joe Cocker, and Elton John.
